apps.description_ar:
Poppy Playtime Chapter 2 Apk is a horror game for children. In it, you look around different places such as an old factory and empty warehouse to find other toys and save Poppy. You have to complete various tasks in order to reach her. This version of the game is even scarier than the first one, so be prepared for some scary moments with dangerous toys!

About Poppy Playtime Chapter 2 Apk
In Poppy Playtime Chapter 2 Apk, you must rescue Poppy from the evil toys. Explore the toy factory, train station, old warehouse, electric room, and other haunted locations to find the clues to the next mission. To reach Poppy, you have to complete three primary levels. All the details are available in the game, and you should follow the rules to unlock the achievements.

The game has many scary scenes, so if you’re under 13, make sure you’re near your Guardian or play the game under proper guidance. If you play the game, you’ll reveal the dark truth about the toy house and follow the facts to save the Poppy.

Features of Poppy Playtime Chapter 2 Apk
It’s the Poppy Playtime Chapter 2 Apk, and new maps and graphics are available in this chapter.

apps.description_ar: Poppy Playtime Chapter 1 – already a classic horror-adventure structure in which players will move very quickly through the corridors and rooms of the toy factory. And all because they will be followed by a distraught animatronic, which, according to the authors’ idea, was just to entertain children. And not to terrify and bring death to everyone who gets into his lair. By an unfortunate coincidence, our main character just landed in this place. So, putting aside the panic, you need to think through the route in advance, avoid dead ends and at the same time work out a plan for the main escape from the current situation.
